en: Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a large military parade in front of a grand stone building with arched windows and balconies crowded with onlookers. In the foreground mounted soldiers ride horses past a dense crowd lining the street; many people wear early‑20th‑century clothing and military uniforms. The print border is rough‑cut, and scale bars for photographic reproduction appear at the bottom.
